# Games.cz — completion and regional schedule report

- Original source: [Games.cz — completion and regional schedule report](https://games.tiscali.cz/tema/robin-hood-legend-of-sherwood-je-hotov-232504)
- Author / publication: jd / Tiscali Games, now Games.cz
- Language / date: Czech; 2002-10-29
- Access: Article text inspected; linked press release could not be retrieved
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The report attributes a completion announcement to Strategy First and says North American shops are expected to receive the game around November 12. It separately anticipates a CD Projekt localized edition for the Czech market early the following year.

The distinction between completion, planned retail arrival, and regional localization is the record's main value. These dates are reported expectations, not independently confirmed shipment dates.

The article links a press release through Blue's News, but that linked text was unreadable in this pass. Character descriptions reproduced alongside the news should not be treated as a final technical specification.
